text: Lead, 2026-10-04: implemented within S6.2 as slice 1. The view is trialFixations(AnalysisRevision, trial), keyed by analysis revision rather than dataset, because MapPlacement (DroppedInitial, OutsideWindow) depends on the recipe's policies and window. It carries StudioRef.Fixation, record, screen x/y, onset ms, duration ms and MapPlacement, as protocol 1.6. S6.3 takes its timing from this view.
